shared_or_similar_visual_information: A right-pointing chevron or arrowhead on a line.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: The matching arrow marks state that SR and PQ are parallel. Right image: It bounds a horizontal-coordinate interval between adjacent peaks of the plotted wave.
Rationales: The left chevrons occur as a matching pair inside geometric sides and assert parallelism. The selected right arrowhead instead bounds a plotted interval or indicates continuation of an axis or function branch, as identified by its attachment to that element.
